install: mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh" && chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh" && if [ -n "${HETZNER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$HETZNER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key" && ssh-keygen -y -f "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key" > "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key.pub" 2>/dev/null || true && echo '[cursor-env] HETZNER deploy key materialized'; elif [ -n "${SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key" && echo '[cursor-env] SSH_PRIVATE_KEY materialized'; else echo '[cursor-env] no HETZNER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY runtime secret — SSH deploy unavailable until owner adds it in Cursor Dashboard → Cloud Agents → Secrets'; fi && cd UNICORN_FINAL && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund
start: export ZEUS_SSH_KEY="${ZEUS_SSH_KEY:-$HOME/.ssh/deploy_key}"; export ZEUS_HOST="${ZEUS_HOST:-${HETZNER_HOST:-204.168.230.142}}"; export ZEUS_USER="${ZEUS_USER:-${HETZNER_DEPLOY_USER:-root}}"; echo "[cursor-env] ZEUS_HOST=$ZEUS_HOST ZEUS_USER=$ZEUS_USER key=${ZEUS_SSH_KEY}"
